title: Glueless Human Hair Body Wave Wig, 20 Inch, 180% Density
description:
A soft, bouncy body wave wig made from 100% human hair that can be curled, straightened and washed like your own. The glueless cap with an adjustable strap goes on in minutes.
• Hair: 100% human hair, 180% density, length 20 inches (51 cm)
• Cap: medium size 54–58 cm with adjustable strap and 4 combs
• Heat-styling safe up to 180 °C; can be dyed darker
• Arrives in a gift box with a wig cap

title: Human Hair Curly Wig with Middle Part, 18 Inch
description:
Defined, springy curls with natural movement for a full, voluminous look. The breathable cap and pre-cut middle part make it easy to wear every day.
• Hair: 100% human hair, 150% density, length 18 inches (46 cm)
• Cap: medium size 54–58 cm with adjustable strap
• Refresh the curls with water and a leave-in conditioner
• Heat-styling safe up to 180 °C

title: Straight Human Hair Bob Wig, 12 Inch, Blunt Cut
description:
A sleek chin-to-shoulder bob with a crisp blunt cut that is easy to style. Lightweight and comfortable for all-day wear.
• Hair: 100% human hair, 150% density, length 12 inches (30 cm)
• Cap: medium size 54–58 cm with adjustable strap and side combs
• Heat-styling safe up to 180 °C; can be dyed darker
• Wig weight approx. 150 g

title: Afro Kinky Curly Human Hair Wig, 14 Inch
description:
A full, rounded afro wig with tight kinky curls for bold, natural-looking volume. The glueless cap is breathable and secure.
• Hair: 100% human hair, 200% density, stretched length 14 inches (36 cm)
• Cap: medium size 54–58 cm with adjustable strap
• Shape with an afro pick and refresh with a light water spray
• Can be dyed darker or colour-toned

title: Shoulder-Length Synthetic Bob Wig with Fringe, Heat-Resistant
description:
A ready-to-wear bob with a soft fringe in bold and natural colours, ideal for parties, costumes or a quick style change. Pre-styled straight out of the box.
• Fibre: heat-resistant synthetic, styling safe up to 150 °C
• Length: approx. 35 cm from the crown
• Cap: average size 54–58 cm, breathable rose-net with adjustable straps
• Includes a wig cap

title: Blue Cosplay Wig, Heat-Resistant Synthetic Fibre
description:
A vivid, layered cosplay wig that holds its colour and shape through long convention days. Easy to trim and style to match your character.
• Fibre: matte heat-resistant synthetic, styling safe up to 150 °C
• Length: approx. 40 cm, layered cut with side-swept fringe
• Cap: average size 54–58 cm with adjustable straps
• Includes a wig cap and storage net

title: Long Wavy Pink Synthetic Wig, 26 Inch
description:
Long, flowing waves in soft candy pink for festivals, photo shoots and themed parties. The fibre has a natural low-shine finish.
• Fibre: heat-resistant synthetic, styling safe up to 150 °C
• Length: 26 inches (66 cm)
• Cap: average size 54–58 cm with adjustable straps
• Brush gently with a wide-tooth comb to keep the waves defined

title: Long Straight Synthetic Wig with Bangs, 24 Inch
description:
A silky, everyday straight wig with face-framing bangs that is ready to wear straight from the pack. A budget-friendly way to try a new look.
• Fibre: heat-resistant synthetic, styling safe up to 150 °C
• Length: 24 inches (61 cm)
• Cap: average size 54–58 cm, breathable with adjustable straps

description:
A sleek straight wig with a 13 × 4 inch transparent lace front for a natural-looking hairline and flexible parting. Pre-plucked with baby hairs for a soft finish.

• Cap: medium size 54–58 cm with adjustable strap and 4 combs

description:
Glamorous long waves in a sun-kissed blonde with darker roots, finished with a soft lace front hairline. A heat-friendly synthetic that holds its wave pattern.

• Length: 26 inches (66 cm)

description:
A rich copper red with soft layered waves that frame the face. The lace front blends in for a natural-looking hairline.

description:
Soft chocolate-brown hair with on-trend curtain bangs and ends that curve gently inward. A natural-looking everyday style with a 13 × 4 lace front.

title: Tape-In Human Hair Extensions, 20 Pieces, 50 g
description:
Seamless tape-in extensions that lie flat against the head to add length and volume. Each piece can be removed and re-taped for repeated use.
• 100% human hair, 20 pieces × 2.5 g (50 g in total)
• Length: 18 inches (46 cm); weft width 4 cm
• Strong double-sided tape, reusable with replacement tapes
• Professional fitting recommended

title: Halo Hair Extension with Invisible Wire, 20 Inch
description:
A one-piece halo extension that sits on an invisible, adjustable wire, with no glue or tape needed. Slip it on in under a minute for instant length and volume.
• Fibre: heat-resistant synthetic, styling safe up to 150 °C
• Length: 20 inches (51 cm); weight approx. 110 g
• Adjustable clear wire plus 4 small security clips
• Brush gently and air-dry after washing

title: Straight Human Hair Weft Bundle, 20 Inch, 100 g
description:

• Length: 20 inches (51 cm)
• Can be dyed darker, or lightened by a professional

title: Wrap-Around Clip-In Ponytail Extension, 22 Inch
description:
A long, sleek ponytail that wraps around your own hair to hide the base, then secures with a comb and a hidden clip. Ready to wear in under a minute.
• Fibre: heat-resistant synthetic, styling safe up to 150 °C
• Length: 22 inches (56 cm); weight approx. 120 g
• Wrap strip with built-in comb and snap clip
• Wear it straight or curl it for extra volume

title: Messy Bun Hair Piece with Elastic Scrunchie Base
description:
An instant tousled updo: wrap the elastic band around a ponytail and the curly bun does the rest. Handy for busy mornings, weddings and evenings out.
• Fibre: synthetic, approx. 40 g
• Elastic scrunchie base fits most ponytails
• Bun diameter approx. 12 cm
• Shake out and reshape with your fingers after wearing

title: Coloured Clip-In Hair Streaks, 10 Pieces
description:

title: Wide-Tooth Detangling Comb for Wigs and Curly Hair
description:
